title: Servicios · carrusel
brief: Section for the Puente NEA landing that names all seven services (software a medida, automatizaciones, bots, agentes, IA para tu negocio, diseño de páginas web, integraciones) without lengthening the page. Inspired by milanote.com/es: short headline, one idea per block, a small artifact per service, a carousel with the next card peeking. Spanish UI copy with voseo, no hype, no invented claims.

artboards.title: Tarjetas altas
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to Milanote: tall cards on a petrol band, each with a small code-built artifact, scroll-snap, round arrows and the next card peeking; the most visual and memorable, but one swipe per few services and the artifacts are the heaviest to build and maintain. Sits between Qué hacemos and Cómo trabajamos.

artboards.title: Selector y panel
artboards.tradeoff: One list of seven names always visible plus one large panel: nothing is hidden behind swiping and every service is one tap away, with the biggest artifact; shows one service at a time and needs a click to read the rest. Continues Qué hacemos on the same paper background; on phones the list becomes a row of chips.

artboards.title: Rejilla densa
artboards.tradeoff: Lightest and densest: all seven services as compact icon cards in a 4-column grid (a two-row swipe rail on tablet and phone), no artifacts, so it is the shortest and the fastest to build; less visual proof of what each service does. Sits right under the Te pasa esto band so the full list is visible from the start.
